facts.statement: The generic name Sinovenator means 'Chinese hunter', combining the Latin word for China and the Latin word for hunter.
facts.quote: The generic name was derived from the Latin word Sinae, for China (in Neo-Latin), and venator hunter.

facts.statement: The species name changii honors Meemann Chang for her work on the Jehol Fauna.
facts.quote: Meemann Chang is honoured by the species name for her contributions to the study of the Jehol Fauna.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen is IVPP V 12615, consisting of a partial skull and a disarticulated skeleton.
facts.quote: The type specimen or holotype of Sinovenator changii is IVPP 12615, a partial skull and disarticulated skeleton.

facts.statement: The paratype specimen is IVPP V 12583, an incomplete but articulated postcranial skeleton.
facts.quote: An additional specimen was by the original publication scientifically described and assigned as the paratype of the species: an incomplete but articulated postcranial skeleton, numbered IVPP 12583.

facts.statement: A wrist specimen, IVPP V14009, was described in 2014 and identified as an adult.
facts.quote: In 2014, the wrist of one specimen was described, IVPP V14009, an adult.

facts.statement: In 2018, specimen PMOL-AD00102, containing a partial skull, mandibles, and six cervical vertebrae, was assigned to Sinovenator.
facts.quote: In 2018, PMOL-AD00102, consisting of a partial skull and mandibles, and six cervical vertebrae, was referred to the taxon.

facts.statement: Sinovenator lived during the Early Cretaceous Period.
facts.quote: It is from the early Cretaceous Period.

facts.statement: Sinovenator lived approximately 125 million years ago during the Aptian stage of the Early Cretaceous in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a principios del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 125 millones de años, en el Aptiense, en lo que hoy es Asia.

facts.statement: Fossils of Sinovenator were found in the oldest section of the Yixian Formation in China.
facts.quote: Dos fósiles fueron encontrados en la porción más antigua de la Formación Yixian en China.

facts.statement: Sinovenator is a genus of troodontid dinosaur from China.
facts.quote: Sinovenator () is a genus of troodontid dinosaur from China.

facts.statement: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated that a one-meter-long Sinovenator weighed 2.5 kilograms.
facts.quote: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated the weight of a one metre long individual at 2.5 kilogrammes.

facts.statement: Although the holotype and paratype are subadults, larger specimens exist that are about twice their length.
facts.quote: However, the holotype and paratype are subadults; specimens are known with about twice their length.

facts.statement: Sinovenator is considered one of the larger troodontid species in the ecosystem of the Yixian Formation.
facts.quote: This makes it one of the larger species of troodontids in the ecosystem of the Yixian Formation, the formation where it was found.

facts.statement: A distinguishing feature of Sinovenator is that the front edge of the antorbital fenestra is straight and vertically oriented.
facts.quote: The front edge of the antorbital fenestra, the large skull opening in front of the eye socket, is straight and vertically oriented.

facts.statement: The surangular bone in the lower jaw of Sinovenator has a T-shaped cross-section.
facts.quote: The surangular in the lower jaw has a T-shaped cross-section.

facts.statement: The third metatarsal of Sinovenator is pinched at the top but remains visible at the upper front, indicating a subarctometatarsal condition.
facts.quote: The third metatarsal is pinched at the top but still visible at the upper front of the metatarsus, conforming to the subarctometatarsal condition.

facts.statement: As troodontids, Sinovenator possessed sickle-claws, raptorial hands, and high encephalization quotients, suggesting advanced behavior and keen senses.
facts.quote: Troodontids have sickle-claws and raptorial hands, and some of the highest non-avian encephalization quotients, meaning they were behaviourally advanced and had keen senses.

facts.statement: Sinovenator was one of the first fossils to conclusively demonstrate the close relationship between troodontids, dromaeosaurids, and Avialae within the group Paraves.
facts.quote: It thus was one of the first fossil specimens conclusively demonstrating the close relation of these three groups in the overarching Paraves.

facts.statement: The lack of a bulla on the underside of the braincase is a basal character of Sinovenator.
facts.quote: Another basal character is the lack of a bulla, a swollen region on the underside of the braincase.

facts.statement: Sinovenator was classified in the family Troodontidae in 2002.
facts.quote: In 2002 Sinovenator was placed in the Troodontidae.

facts.statement: A 2017 study by Shen et al. placed Sinovenator in a monophyletic group called Sinovenatorinae with other Yixian Formation troodontids.
facts.quote: In 2017, a study by Shen et al., describing the genus Daliansaurus found Sinovenator to form a monophyletic group with other troodontids from the Yixian Formation, named Sinovenatorinae.

facts.statement: A 2018 study by Yin et al. suggested that Chinese troodontids, including Sinovenator, form an intermediate grade rather than a distinct subfamily.
facts.quote: A 2018 study by Yin et al. instead found the Chinese troodontids to form an intermediate grade:

facts.statement: There was a debate regarding the age of Sinovenator fossils, originally thought to be Hauterivian but later research indicated they are younger.
facts.quote: Originally, the basal position of Sinovenator seemed to be corroborated by a very high age, the fossils being assumed to date from the Hauterivian. Later research however, indicated that the layers were younger.

facts.statement: Hundreds of undescribed Sinovenator fossils are known from the Lujiatun Beds, suggesting the species was common in that area.
facts.quote: However, Sinovenator fossils appear to be common in the Lujiatun Beds. In a 2006 survey of the Jehol Biota, Xu and Norell reported that hundreds of undescribed specimens are known.

facts.statement: Sinovenator fossils are notable for being preserved in three dimensions rather than being strongly compressed on a slab.
facts.quote: The fossils have been preserved three-dimensionally, not strongly compressed on a slab.

facts.statement: Sinovenator was a troodontid, a group of small, graceful maniraptorans resembling birds.
facts.quote: Sinovenator es un troodóntido , un grupo de pequeños maniraptoranos gráciles, parecidos a pájaros.

facts.statement: All troodontids share unique skull features, including closely packed teeth in the lower jaw.
facts.quote: Todos los troodóntidos tienen muchas características únicas del cráneo, como dientes muy juntos en la mandíbula inferior y una gran cantidad de estos.

facts.statement: Troodontids possessed sickle-shaped claws, raptorial hands, and high non-avian encephalization quotients indicating advanced behavior and keen senses.
facts.quote: Tienen garras en forma de hoz y manos rapaces y algunos de los cocientes de encefalización no aviares más altos , lo que significa que tenían un comportamiento avanzado y sentidos agudos.

facts.statement: The holotype individual of Sinovenator was approximately the size of a chicken, less than one meter long.
facts.quote: El individuo holotipo de Sinovenator tenía aproximadamente el tamaño de un pollo, menos de un metro de largo.

facts.statement: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated that a Sinovenator individual one meter long weighed 2.5 kilograms.
facts.quote: En 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimó el peso de un individuo de un metro de largo en 2,5 kilogramos.

facts.statement: Specimens known to be approximately twice the length of the holotype have been found.
facts.quote: Se conocen ejemplares con aproximadamente el doble de su longitud.

facts.statement: This makes Sinovenator one of the largest troodontid species in the Yixian Formation ecosystem where it was found.
facts.quote: Esto lo convierte en una de las especies más grandes de troodóntidos en el ecosistema de la Formación Yixian, la formación donde se encontró.

facts.statement: The anterior border of the anteorbital fenestra, the large opening in the skull in front of the eye socket, is straight and oriented vertically.
facts.quote: El borde frontal de la fenestra anteorbital, la gran abertura del cráneo frente a la cuenca del ojo, es recto y está orientado verticalmente.

facts.statement: The frontal bone displays a vertical crest that touches the lacrimal bone.
facts.quote: El hueso frontal muestra una cresta vertical que toca el hueso lagrimal.

facts.statement: The surangular in the lower jaw has a T-shaped cross-section.
facts.quote: El surangular en la mandíbula inferior tiene una sección transversal en forma de T.

facts.statement: The tibia has a vertical crest on the upper outer side, the cnemial crest, which touches a lower vertical crest, the fibular crest.
facts.quote: La tibia tiene una cresta vertical en el lado exterior superior, la crista cnemialis, que toca una cresta vertical inferior, la crista fibularis.

facts.statement: The upper branch of the premaxilla excludes the maxilla from the nasal fossa.
facts.quote: La rama superior del pramaxila excluye el maxilar de la fosa nasal.

facts.statement: The premaxillary teeth lack denticles.
facts.quote: Los dientes premaxilares carecen de dentículos.

facts.statement: The maxillary teeth are small.
facts.quote: Los de los dientes maxilares son pequeños.

facts.statement: The row of maxillary teeth is placed at a certain distance from the jaw edge.
facts.quote: La fila de dientes maxilares se coloca a cierta distancia del borde de la mandíbula.

facts.statement: A promaxillary fenestra is present.
facts.quote: Una fenestra promaxilar está presente.

facts.statement: The jugal branch toward the postorbital is long, thin, and inclined backward.
facts.quote: La rama del yugal hacia el postorbitario es larga, delgada e inclinada hacia atrás.

facts.statement: The foramen magnum is much larger than the occipital condyle.
facts.quote: El foramen magnum es mucho más grande que el cóndilo occipital.

facts.statement: The posterior part of the pterygoid has a secondary rod-shaped process.
facts.quote: La parte posterior del pterigoideo tiene un proceso secundario en forma de varilla.

facts.statement: The anterior dentary teeth are very closely packed.
facts.quote: Los dientes dentarios anteriores están muy juntos.

facts.statement: The posterior part of the surangular is extraordinarily deep.
facts.quote: La parte trasera del surangular es extraordinariamente profunda.

facts.statement: There are five sacral vertebrae, with the middle ones being clearly larger.
facts.quote: Están presentes cinco sacros, siendo los del medio claramente más grandes.

facts.statement: The ilium is relatively small.
facts.quote: El ilion es relativamente pequeño.

facts.statement: The ischium is bird-like, small, with a low obturator process and processes on the upper and lower posterior edges.
facts.quote: El isquion es similar a un pájaro, pequeño con un proceso obturador bajo y procesos en el borde posterior superior e inferior.

facts.statement: The tibia is wide at the top and has an approximately rectangular lower articular surface.
facts.quote: La tibia es ancha en la parte superior y tiene una superficie articular inferior aproximadamente rectangular.

facts.statement: The fourth metatarsal is not well developed, but the second metatarsal is small.
facts.quote: El cuarto metatarsiano no está muy desarrollado pero el segundo metatarsiano es pequeño.

facts.statement: The third metatarsal is pinched at the top but still visible at the upper front of the metatarsus, consistent with the subarctometatarsalian condition.
facts.quote: El tercer metatarsiano está pellizcado en la parte superior pero aún visible en la parte frontal superior del metatarso, conforme a la condición subarctometatarsiana.

facts.statement: Two specimens of a troodontid were described in 2002.
facts.quote: En 2002 se describieron dos ejemplares de un troodóntido.

facts.statement: Xu Xing, Mark Norell, and colleagues wrote the study describing the specimens and found they represented a new taxon named Sinovenator changii.
facts.quote: Xu Xing , Mark Norell y sus colegas escribieron el estudio que los describe y encontraron que las muestras representan un nuevo taxón, para el cual se eligió el binomio Sinovenator changii.

facts.statement: The generic name was derived from the Latin word Sinae for China and Venator, meaning "hunter".
facts.quote: El nombre genérico se derivó de la palabra latina Sinae, para China , y Venator , o "cazador".

facts.statement: Meemann Chang is honored with the species name for her contributions to the study of Jehol fauna.
facts.quote: Meemann Chang es honrada con el nombre de la especie por sus contribuciones al estudio de la fauna de Jehol.

facts.statement: The holotype of Sinovenator changii is IVPP 12615, consisting of a partial skull and a disarticulated skeleton.
facts.quote: El espécimen tipo u holotipo de Sinovenator changii es IVPP 12615, un cráneo parcial y un esqueleto desarticulado.

facts.statement: The original publication scientifically described and assigned an additional specimen as the paratype, an incomplete but articulated postcranial skeleton numbered IVPP 12583.
facts.quote: La publicación original describió científicamente y asignó un espécimen adicional como el paratipo de la especie, un esqueleto postcraneal incompleto pero articulado, numerado IVPP 12583.

facts.statement: A third specimen, IVPP V14322, a fragmentary skeleton, has been referred to the species.
facts.quote: Se refirió un tercer espécimen, IVPP V14322, un esqueleto fragmentario.

facts.statement: All three specimens are housed in the IVPP collection in Beijing, China.
facts.quote: Los tres están en la colección del IVPP en Beijing, China.

facts.statement: However, Sinovenator fossils appear to be common in the Lujiatun sites.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, los fósiles de Sinovenator parecen ser comunes en los yacimientos de Lujiatun.

facts.statement: In a 2006 survey of Jehol Biota, Xu and Norell reported that hundreds of undescribed specimens are known.
facts.quote: En una encuesta de 2006 de la Biota de Jehol, Xu y Norell informaron que se conocen cientos de especímenes no descritos.

facts.statement: The fossils have been preserved three-dimensionally, not strongly compressed into a slab.
facts.quote: Los fósiles se han conservado tridimensionalmente, no fuertemente comprimidos en una losa.

facts.statement: In 2014, the wrist of an adult specimen, IVPP V14009, was described.
facts.quote: En 2014 se describió la muñeca de un ejemplar, IVPP V14009, un adulto.

facts.statement: In 2018, PMOL-AD00102, consisting of a partial skull and jaws and six cervical vertebrae, was referred to the taxon.
facts.quote: En 2018, PMOL-AD00102, que consta de un cráneo y mandíbulas parciales, y seis vértebras cervicales, se refirió al taxón.

facts.statement: In 2002, Sinovenator was placed in the family Troodontidae.
facts.quote: En 2002, Sinovenator se colocó en Troodontidae.

facts.statement: Sinovenator is a basal or "primitive" troodontid that shares characteristics with most dromaeosaurids and basal Avialae.
facts.quote: Sinovenator es un troodóntido basal o "primitivo" y comparte características con la mayoría de los dromeosáuridos y Avialae basales.

facts.statement: Therefore, it was one of the first fossil specimens to conclusively demonstrate the close relationship of these three groups within the general Paraves.
facts.quote: Por lo tanto, fue uno de los primeros especímenes fósiles que demostró de manera concluyente la estrecha relación de estos tres grupos en el general Paraves.

facts.statement: A typical basal trait is the backward orientation of the pubis bone, similar to the situation in Dromaeosauridae and basal birds.
facts.quote: Un rasgo basal típico es la orientación del hueso púbico hacia atrás, similar a la situación en los Dromaeosauridae y las aves basales.

facts.statement: This proves that the forward orientation in later troodontids is an inversion and not a trait inherited directly from older theropods that also possess a forward-pointing pubis bone.
facts.quote: Esto prueba que la orientación hacia el frente con los troodóntidos posteriores es una inversión y no un rasgo heredado directamente de los terópodos más antiguos que también poseen un hueso púbico que apunta hacia adelante.

facts.statement: Another basal character is the lack of a bulla, an inflated region at the bottom of the cranial box.
facts.quote: Otro carácter basal es la falta de bulla, una región inflamada en la parte inferior de la caja craneana.

facts.statement: This indicates that the similar bulla with Ornithomimosauria represents a case of parallel evolution and is not evidence for Bullatosauria, a supposed earlier close relationship between troodontids and ornithomimosaurians.
facts.quote: Esto indica que la bulla similar con Ornithomimosauria presenta un caso de evolución paralela y no es una prueba para Bullatosauria, una supuesta relación cercana anterior entre troodóntidos y ornitomimosaurianos.

facts.statement: Originally, the basal position of Sinovenator seemed corroborated by a very old age, assuming the fossils dated to the Hauterivian.
facts.quote: Originalmente, la posición basal de Sinovenator parecía estar corroborada por una edad muy alta, asumiéndose que los fósiles datan del Hauteriviense.

facts.statement: However, subsequent research indicated that the layers were younger.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, investigaciones posteriores indicaron que las capas eran más jóvenes.

facts.statement: In 2017, a study by Shen et al., describing the genus Daliansaurus, found that Sinovenator formed a monophyletic group with other Yixian Formation troodontids called Sinovenatorinae.
facts.quote: En 2017, un estudio de Shen et al., describiendo el género Daliansaurus encontró que Sinovenator formaba un grupo monofilético con otros troodontidos de la Formación Yixian, llamado Sinovenatorinae.

facts.statement: It was found that a wide and flattened fourth metatarsal was a synapomorphy uniting this group.
facts.quote: Se encontró que un cuarto metatarsiano ancho y aplanado era una sinapomorfia que unía a este grupo.

facts.statement: A 2018 study by Yin et al. instead found that Chinese troodontids formed an intermediate grade.
facts.quote: Un estudio de 2018 de Yin et al. en cambio, encontró que los troodóntidos chinos formaban un grado intermedio.

facts.statement: Sinovenator lived during the Barremian to Aptian stages, from 125.77 to 119.57 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Barremian to Aptian (125.77 to 119.57 million years ago)

facts.statement: Four fossil occurrences of Sinovenator have been recorded.
facts.quote: Fossil occurrences recorded: 4
